_reasoningEffortOptions: GLM-5.2 and above only (older GLM models have no tunable effort). GLM-5.3/-FLASH: "low" | "high" | "max" only (default "max" - any other value errors). GLM-5.2: also accepts "none" | "minimal" | "medium" | "xhigh" (default "max"); "none"/"minimal" stop thinking, "low"/"medium" collapse to "high", "xhigh" collapses to "max". Requires thinking.type: "enabled" - GLM-5.3 can no longer disable thinking at all, so migrate any thinking.type: "disabled" callers to reasoningEffort "low" first.
